title: A first look at TIGmo, our new fully automated trading technology
author: TradeIdeasPro
selftext:
We've been working on something big at Trade Ideas and wanted to share a quick preview.

TIGmo is designed to take trading automation to the next level, from identifying opportunities to executing trades and managing positions, all hands-free.

Here's a short demo of the technology in action. Curious to hear what this community thinks!
